Meet Endless Mountains Hair Designs

A full-service family salon

Endless Mountains Hair Designs

Endless Mountains Hair Designs is a full-service family salon on E Tioga St in Tunkhannock, PA. One stop for the whole family's hair, plus nails, lashes and facials.

On the hair side: hair color, highlights, perms and haircuts, plus hair extensions when you want more length to work with.

On the nail side: manicures and pedicures, acrylic nails and hand-painted nail art. The sets in the gallery below are the salon's own work. Round out the visit with a lash lift or a facial.

Book by phone

Appointments are by phone at (570) 996-0363. There is no online booking, so call the salon to grab your slot.

Hair, nails, lashes & skin

Color, highlights, perms and cuts, plus manicures and pedicures, acrylics, lash lifts, extensions and facials, all under one roof.

On E Tioga St

86 E Tioga St #2 in Tunkhannock. A full-service family salon in the Endless Mountains.
